motion_sampling.method: Actual Next action constructs real WAAPI effects. Pause every effect and sample its normalized currentTime while preserving DOM, then resume and verify natural after-state commit. Native scene PNGs inspected.
motion_sampling.repeated_primitive_grouping: Execute examples cover same physical plot/number-line/lanes pulse-and-commit rendering with register Incoming docks. Loaded-tick separately exercises copy semantics. Authority commit exercises changed pool, sequence and chamber cells.
motion_sampling.physical_limit: Physical plot curves and markers pulse/fade at the committed before-state and jump to declared after-state at commit. These captures do not show continuous physical dynamics or a qualified trajectory.

shared_controls.scope: Shared runtime controls evidence; its source/preview limits remain explicit and it does not substitute for this emitted endpoint review.

findings.description: Narrow lane axis 0 and 40 now use separate vertical label rows; quantitative positions unchanged.
Nonholonomic body footprint keeps rigid proportions in common schematic x/y length units, using equal-axis letterboxing in all profiles.
Negative onset margin -30 ms and thermal deadline slack -190 microseconds remain readable; execution bound and response deadline remain distinct.
Narrow retained Snapshot pool column is clipped at right edge; source identity/owner/state text is truncated. Runtime author reports correction in next freeze, not yet accepted in emitted build.

Selected serve-to-read frames show Incoming sensor identity and generic Update badge but no visible Sensor epoch S carrier route. Source clipping may prevent a valid route. Must inspect corrected emitted geometry.
Narrow authority commit generic Update badges wrap over protocol cell faces. Runtime author reports generic word badges removed in next freeze.

limits: No real student testing, usability study, measured learning gain, hardware timing qualification, or physical safety validation.
All cases/states covered as endpoints; one selected transition per lesson/profile sampled, not every transition/variant motion.
Captures and native contact sheets remain local under qa-final-vol4-c and qa-final-vol4-c-motion; this public report binds PNG basenames and SHA256 without copying images into repository.
No acceptance record or overlay created. New runtime changes invalidate the current runtime binding until a clean emitted build is rechecked.
